question: The Sakraat festival is celebrated with the 'Budigali' or 'Kalasi' dance _____________, in where women take part in this dance, carrying decorative pots on their heads.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sakraat festival is celebrated in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• During this festival, the 'Budigali' or 'Kalasi' dance is performed.
 
• Women participate in this dance by carrying decorative pots on their heads.
 
• This dance is a significant cultural event, showcasing the traditional customs and practices of the region.
 
• The festival and dance are part of the rich cultural heritage of Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odisha is known for its diverse cultural festivals and traditional dances.
 
• The state has a vibrant cultural history, with various forms of dance, music, and art.
 
• Other notable festivals in Odisha include Rath Yatra, Durga Puja, and Diwali, among others.
 
• The traditional dances and festivals play a crucial role in preserving the cultural identity and heritage of the people of Odisha.
